notes.text: The About Us page states 67,000 MVA annual capacity across six facilities, and says a second Chihuahua plant began operations in October 2022. Checked 15 Oct 2026.

The SGB-SMIT news page dated 13 July 2026 says the group has signed an agreement to take a majority stake in COMEL Transformatori and that the step strengthens its European power transformer network. Closing is expected in the second half of 2026.
